name: ea_packaging_submission
description: UK Environment Agency EPR packaging data submission

tables.name: packaging_submission
tables.description: Curated packaging records ready for EA submission

columns.name: submission_id
columns.description: Unique record identifier. Build with concat of Record ID, Period, Site Ref and Packaging Material Code.

columns.name: reporting_period
columns.description: Normalised reporting period YYYY-QN. Source formats: '2024-Q1', 'Q2 2024', '2024Q3'. Use case-insensitive regex matching and always output 'YYYY-QN'.

columns.name: organisation_id
columns.description: Organisation identifier. Direct map from Org Code.

columns.name: site_id
columns.description: Site reference. Direct map from Site Ref.

columns.name: nation
columns.description: Nation where packaging was handled. Use a lookup transformation with site_locations.csv keyed on site_ref returning nation. Source column is Site Ref.

columns.name: packaging_material
columns.description: EA packaging material category. Use a lookup transformation with material_reference.csv keyed on internal_code returning ea_material_name. Source column is Packaging Material Code.

columns.name: packaging_class
columns.description: Packaging class. Map case-insensitively from the first word of Packaging Type: Primary, Secondary, Shipment, Tertiary.

columns.name: activity
columns.description: Packaging activity. Normalise case-insensitively: supplied -> 'Supplied as goods', import/imported -> 'Imported', export/exported -> 'Exported'.

columns.name: weight_tonnes
columns.description: Weight in tonnes. If Unit is 'kg' or 'KG' divide Weight by 1000, otherwise keep Weight as tonnes. Cast to Float64.

columns.name: submission_date
columns.description: Date of record. Try formats '%d/%m/%Y', '%Y-%m-%d', '%d-%b-%Y' using coalesce.
